name: h2_moses2023
description: Quantinuum H2 as published in 2305.03828 (v2): one closed race-track RF null with no junctions; 4 DG gate zones that gate, prepare and measure, 4 UG gate zones that only sort, 5 auxiliary parking blocks per rail, two broadcast conveyor regions of 20 wells each, and a load hole in the middle of the left one. Capacities in qubits (one qubit = one 171Yb+-138Ba+ pair). Positions in units of the 750 um gate pitch. Primitive times are UNIT times: the paper states none.

provenance.citation: S. A. Moses et al., A Race Track Trapped-Ion Quantum Processor, Phys. Rev. X 13, 041052 (2023)
provenance.pitch_source: 2305.03828 Sec. II.A: 'the spacing between gate zones remains the same (750 um)'
provenance.figure_scale_check: Fig. 2d drawn at 56.0 pt per 750 um: DC extent 6.58 mm and isthmus 2.02 mm (Fig. 1 caption) agree to 1%
provenance.well_pitch_source: not stated: 20 wells spread evenly over the conveyor arc of Fig. 2d (the figure's storage ions sit ~149 um apart)
provenance.electrodes: 376 electrodes, 268 independent voltage sources, 1 RF drive, 280-pin CPGA (Sec. II.A); per-zone electrode counts not stated
provenance.rf: ~200 V, 42 MHz; ions 70 um from the surface (Sec. II.A, Fig. 2c)
provenance.operated_qubits: 32 (Abstract); four batches of 8 in the DG zones, the UG zones and each storage region (Sec. II.E)
provenance.two_qubit_parallelism: up to four 2Q gates per round (Table I caption): four 2Q beam pairs for four gate zones (Sec. II.C)
provenance.measured: 2Q 1.84(5)e-3 (Abstract; Table II 18.3(5)e-4), 1Q 2.5(3)e-5, SPAM 1.6(1)e-3, transport 1Q RB 2.2(3)e-4 (Table II)
provenance.times: none stated for any primitive; this document's times are unit times
provenance.control: Gate and auxiliary regions have independently driven electrodes (268 sources for 376 electrodes, 2305.03828 Sec. II.A) and the paper states no one-waveform-per-cycle rule, so control.model is 'direct' (R22 off). The one broadcast constraint it does state -- the conveyor wells are tied to three signals {a,b,c} (Sec. II.A) -- is control.channels, which R4d judges: loaded conveyor wells move together, the same way.

dg.note: DG gate zone. gate/spam: 'only the DG zones are used for quantum operations (gating, state preparation, and measurement)' (2305.03828 Sec. II.A). capacity 2 qubits: a 2Q gate runs on 'two YB pairs combined into a single four-ion crystal YBBY' (Sec. II.E, Fig. 2e) and a batch of 8 fills the 4 DG zones (Sec. II.E). cool: Doppler sheet beams cover the trap (Sec. II.E, Fig. 2d); the resolved sideband cooling applied here before every 2Q round is NOT expressible as a zone capability.

ug.note: UG gate zone: 'we use both rows for ion rearrangement (physical swaps), but only the DG zones are used for quantum operations' (2305.03828 Sec. II.A); 'used for sorting but not quantum operations' (Fig. 2d caption). capacity 2: a batch of 8 in the 4 UG zones (Sec. II.E). The PMT array could detect here (Sec. II.D) but does not, so spam is false.

aux.note: auxiliary region (light grey, Fig. 2d; 2305.03828 Sec. II.A). NOT stated: how many (5 per rail read from Fig. 2d) and capacity (2 assumed: Fig. 2d parks one pair of qubits per block, and 'Ions in the UG zones are transported to the nearby auxiliary zones', Sec. II.E). No gating, no SPAM.

conveyor.note: conveyor-belt storage well: '{a,b,c,...} ... can support 20 wells on each side (one for every three electrodes)' (2305.03828 Sec. II.A). capacity 1 qubit (one YB pair per well) is read from Fig. 2h, not stated in the text.

load.note: load hole 'in the middle of the left-side conveyor belt region ... surrounded by electrodes with independent signals' (2305.03828 Sec. II.A); photo-ionization beams (Sec. II.B). NOT stated: its capacity (1 YB pair assumed).

curve.label: unit time for a linear shift (Sec. II.E); not stated by 2305.03828 (Sec. II.E); quanta not stated either
unit time for split (Sec. II.E 'split/combine'); not stated by 2305.03828 (Sec. II.E); quanta not stated either
unit time for combine (Sec. II.E 'split/combine'); not stated by 2305.03828 (Sec. II.E); quanta not stated either
unit time for a physical swap (Sec. II.E); not stated by 2305.03828 (Sec. II.E); quanta not stated either

ms_gate.note: 2305.03828 states no duration for this primitive (Sec. II.E gives only whole-shot times, Table I); 1 us is a unit so the replay counts operations. Times from this document are never compared.
ms_gate.gate: U_ZZ(theta) = exp(-i theta ZZ/2): an MS gate between 1Q wrapper pulses (Sec. II.C)

1q_gate.note: 2305.03828 states no duration for this primitive (Sec. II.E gives only whole-shot times, Table I); 1 us is a unit so the replay counts operations. Times from this document are never compared.

measure.note: 2305.03828 states no duration for this primitive (Sec. II.E gives only whole-shot times, Table I); 1 us is a unit so the replay counts operations. Times from this document are never compared.
measure.fidelity_source: 2305.03828 Abstract: SPAM 1.6(1)e-3 (preparation and measurement together, not measurement alone)

reset.note: 2305.03828 states no duration for this primitive (Sec. II.E gives only whole-shot times, Table I); 1 us is a unit so the replay counts operations. Times from this document are never compared.

cool.note: 2305.03828 states no duration for this primitive (Sec. II.E gives only whole-shot times, Table I); 1 us is a unit so the replay counts operations. Times from this document are never compared.
cool.physics: Doppler 'sheet beams' cover the whole trap during transport (2305.03828 Sec. II.E, Fig. 2d). The resolved sideband cooling of the Ba+ ions in the DG zones 'before 2Q gating operations' (Sec. II.E) is a second, zone-scoped step the language cannot state.

species.source: 2305.03828 Sec. II.B: '32 171Yb+-138Ba+ [YB] pairs in a deterministic orientation'; one coolant per qubit, so half the ions
species.unit_of_capacity: every capacity in this document counts qubits = YB pairs
species.T1: 'finite T1 time of several minutes' (Sec. II.E): no number, so no T_coh_s

extra.note: linear shift of one qubit (YB pair) between neighbouring zones or wells: Sec. II.E 'linear shifts'. The id is the name our compiler emits for a single-ion move.
Sec. II.E: 'batch shift, which shuttles batches of ions collectively to different regions of the trap'; one step along the loop
the same, the other way round the loop

channels.note: conveyor.a/b/c: 'equally spaced and sized electrodes tied together in a repeating fashion ({a,b,c,a,b,c,...}). This requires only three total voltage signals' (Sec. II.A); read literally as three signals for BOTH regions (the text is ambiguous). Every other site is independently driven. The channel count this map gives is NOT H2's 268 sources: the paper does not state electrodes per zone.

wiring.note: 376 electrodes, 268 independent voltage sources, 1 RF drive; 280-pin ceramic pin grid array (Sec. II.A)

optical.note: four 2Q Raman beam pairs operate the four DG zones; 1Q gates use co-propagating beams; measurement beams per DG zone; a PMT array sees all 8 gate zones (Sec. II.C-D)
